primary.title: Income Tax rules: Delhi ITAT holds capital gains on transfer of US entity not taxable in India — Expert explains why
primary.summary: Income Tax rules: The Delhi Bench of the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT) has held that capital gains on transfer of a US entity, in the case of FireEye Ireland, is not taxable in India. Expert explains why…

related.title: Key income tax rules: Foreign Disclosure Scheme – What happens if taxman values your assets higher than you declared?
related.summary: The Foreign Disclosure Scheme 2026 offers eligible taxpayers a one-time opportunity to declare undisclosed foreign assets. But what if the taxman values your assets higher than what you declared? Here are the key rules you need to know.
